en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a quiet cobblestone street ending at a small, simple two‑story house with a steep tiled roof and two chimneys. The house stands alone at the end of the lane, with older stone buildings and a high wall to the left and a large dark façade on the right, partly in shadow. Tree branches overhang the street from the upper left, casting shadows on the pavement. The image is framed with a light border typical of vintage photographic postcards. No visible caption or printed text appears on the front.
